judgement: tests/fixtures/decompose-stability/189-gate1-run1/judgement.md — the first run, over a task file that stated the same requirement in three sections. The duplicate pairs it produced were real and run 2's merge of them was right.
summary: Shaped like a control and deliberately not a trivial one. Its bite is the open question: run 1 raised the output-format question, which is correct, so a decomposer that drops questions loses recall here. Its task file is the only one of the seven that names neither symbol, so no symbol requirement applies.
